symptom: ako/mxcli#1838 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1689): CONV013 'uses Rollback error handling instead of Custom' fired on a call to CommunityCommons.ThrowException (a deliberate rollback) and on Java action calls inside a loop, where custom handling is CE0644 — one rule or another always fired.
cause: findUnhandledCalls descended into loop bodies and treated every Java action call alike.
insight: A lint rule and a check rule that demand opposite things for the same element (CONV013 vs MDL006/CE0644) are a defect in the lint rule: check encodes what Studio Pro accepts. Grep the CE number across mdl/executor before deciding which side is right.
